_comment: Fragment 22 — D-65 rejects the R3+C-14+0002 bundle; G62 CI gates fail; G63 merge=union. Merged 2026-08-21.

nodes.label: D-65 — The R3+C-14+0002 Bundle Is Rejected
nodes.description: The three remaining items were described as a single decision blocked on the same guardrail. They are not one decision, and two of the three are blocked on things the guardrail has nothing to do with. Revised sequence: Stage A remediate the CI gates, Stage B install R3, Stage C add C-14 detection, Stage D migration 0002 gated on Q11 and the S1 window.
nodes.rationale: 0002 is blocked on Q11, which is open, and the block is irreversible because NFR-02 makes workflow_transitions append-only — a guessed field name ships permanently. It is also a different risk class: R3 and C-14 are reversible tooling while 0002 is a one-way migration against a live provisioned database. Bundling makes the riskiest item inherit the cadence of the safest.

nodes.label: G62 — Both CI Gates Fail Today
nodes.description: Verified 2026-08-21. bun run typecheck exits 2 with ten implicit-any errors across lib/supabase/middleware.ts and lib/supabase/server.ts, TS7006 twice and TS7031 eight times. bun run lint exits 1: next lint is deprecated and interactive, opening an ESLint configuration wizard, and no ESLint config exists in the repository. Blocks R3 DoD D-4.
nodes.rationale: The lint failure is the worse of the two: an interactive prompt in CI does not fail cleanly, it hangs until the job times out, which reads as an infrastructure fault rather than a code defect. Part b is a decision rather than a fix, since next lint is removed in Next.js 16 so keeping it is not durable.

nodes.label: Specified Against a Config File, Not the Thing
nodes.description: SPECS-VERIFICATION-APPARATUS §4 listed bun run typecheck and bun run lint as CI steps. The script names were taken from package.json and never executed. Neither passes.
nodes.rationale: Fourth instance of deriving a claim from a summary rather than the thing summarised, after G55, G56, D-51's nine commands and G61's five rows — and the first where the summary was a config file rather than a document. A script name in package.json asserts that a script exists, never that it succeeds.

nodes.label: TC6 Is Concealment, Not Risk — and It Has a Number
nodes.description: next.config.ts sets ignoreBuildErrors true. That was recorded as a risk. It is an active concealment with measurable content: ten real type errors present since scaffolding that nothing has ever reported.
nodes.rationale: Strengthens the case for explicit CI gates while simultaneously giving them a prerequisite nobody had scoped. The errors sit in Supabase scaffolding rather than project-authored code, which makes the fix low-risk and the concealment worse.

nodes.label: G63 — merge=union on Markdown
nodes.description: An untracked .gitattributes sets *.md text eol=lf merge=union. Union merge resolves a conflict by keeping both sides, so a conflicting edit to §5.1 would produce duplicate rows rather than a conflict — the G39 defect that carried both Closed and Open for one ID. Found incidentally, outside the asked scope.
nodes.rationale: Cuts against D-58, which rests on conflicts surfacing as silent overwrites. merge=union adds a second silent failure mode, silent concatenation, and unlike an overwrite it leaves no losing version to recover. Latent rather than active: the file is untracked so it affects only this working copy, and with zero merge commits no merge has ever run.
